sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know what's the deadliest weapon up close in the Arena? A shotgun! One point-blank blast and your opponent's practically scraping off the walls. Learn to handle it properly, and nothing will be able to stop you. Guess what it takes to get there? Practice, of course. Lots and lots of practice."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +30,000 EXP
- +300 Shotguns skill points
- 25 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
